options.title: Organize Your Tasks
options.description: Choose how you'd like to organize your GSD tasks in Home Assistant

show_due_in.name: Days ahead to show upcoming tasks
show_due_in.description: Show tasks due within this many days (0 shows all tasks)

create_unified_list.name: Create "All Tasks" list
create_unified_list.description: Show all household tasks in a single todo list

create_assignee_lists.name: Create individual task lists per person
create_assignee_lists.description: Create separate todo lists for each person assigned to tasks

refresh_interval.name: How often to check GSD for changes
refresh_interval.description: How often to poll the GSD server for new and updated chores
